author: Do_You_Compute
body: I have alts that i park at locations with 4+ gauntlets.   While on my way to or from work, I will go a little bit out of my way and activate way vessels i have at these spots.  This will allow me to farm  those dungeons every hour while at work.  I'm normally doing 20+ dungeons a day thanks to this method.
